hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: An on-chain aggregator hook that intercepts swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, routing across up to 4 pre-configured V3 and V4 pools (WBTC/USDC pairs). It computes optimal routes by sorting pools by effective price, executes sub-swaps, collects a service fee via donate, and returns the combined delta to the PoolManager.
